messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 3.4.2

3.4.2. Moving transmission parts By way of exception to section 1.3.8.1, in the case of engines, moveable guards preventing access to the moving parts in the engine compartment need not have interlocking devices if they have to be opened either by the use of a tool or key or by a control located in the driving position, providing the latter is in a fully enclosed cab with a lock to prevent unauthorised access.

response.text:
Moveable guards preventing access to moving parts in the engine compartment | needNotHave | interlocking devices | they have to be opened either by the use of a tool or key or by a control located in the driving position | "moveable guards preventing access to the moving parts in the engine compartment need not have interlocking devices if they have to be opened either by the use of a tool or key or by a control located in the driving position"
Section 1.3.8.1 | isExceptedFor | engines (moveable guards over engine moving parts) | "" | "By way of exception to section 1.3.8.1, in the case of engines"
Driving-position control for opening engine guards | requiresCab | fully enclosed cab with a lock to prevent unauthorised access | the driving-position control is used to open the guard | "providing the latter is in a fully enclosed cab with a lock to prevent unauthorised access"
